304:         let ev = match self.receiver.registration().poll_read_ready(&mut cx) {
305:             Poll::Ready(Ok(ev)) => ev,
306:             Poll::Ready(Err(e)) => panic!("reactor gone: {}", e),
307:             Poll::Pending => return, // No wake has arrived, bail
308:         };

310:         // Drain the pipe completely so we can receive a new readiness event
311:         // if another signal has come in.
312:         let mut buf = [0; 128];
313:         loop {
314:             match (&*self.receiver).read(&mut buf) {

318:                 Err(e) => panic!("Bad read on self-pipe: {}", e),
